title: Dulce de Leche Cheesecake with a Maria Cookie Crust.
hookLine: Global-inspired dulce de leche cheesecake with a maria cookie crust. with 8 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 325ºF. Place cookies in bowl of food processor. Pulse 30 seconds, or until finely ground. (Or, crush them by hand by placing cookies in zip-top bag and using the bottom of a heavy skillet, pound cookies until finely crushed); transfer cookie crumbs to bowl. Add softened butter, stirring until combined. Transfer cookie mixture to 9” spring form pan. Using your fingers, press cookie crumbs evenly onto bottom and sides of pan. Bake until firm and fragrant, about 10 minutes. Incorporate {m53543_1}, {m53543_2}, {m53543_3}, and {m53543_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure maria cookies first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Set electric mixer on medium speed, beat cream cheese until fluffy, about 3 minutes. Add condensed milk; beat until smooth, 1 minute. Beat in eggs, vanilla and 3 tbsp. dulce de leche (caramel) until combined, 3 minutes. Pour filling into prepared crust. Bake until golden brown and set, but still a little wiggly in the middle, 45 – 55 minutes. Incorporate {m53543_5}, {m53543_6}, {m53543_7}, and {m53543_8} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Portion, Shape & Layer Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Turn off oven; partially open oven door. Let cheesecake sit in oven until it come to room temperature, about 1 hour. Transfer cheesecake to refrigerator; cool completely, at least 4 hours. Remove cooled cheesecake from sprigform pan.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Place remaining dulce de leche in ziplock bag. Using scissors, snip small hole in corner of bag. Applying even pressure on “pastry bag,” paint stripes on your finished cheesecake.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
